en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph showing an old, large, and ornate building, likely of historical significance. The building has arched windows, a prominent archway, and a turret-like roof section, with bare trees lining the street. Several people are walking or standing on what appears to be a quiet road. The top right of the image includes multi-lingual text indicating it is an old-time view of Zagreb.
